question: The main object of Manufacturing Account is to show:
solution:
The correct answer is **cost of finished goods produced.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cost of finished goods produced:**

 
 
• The Manufacturing Account is primarily prepared to determine the cost of goods that have been manufactured during a particular accounting period.
 
• This involves calculating direct costs such as raw materials, labor, and manufacturing overheads.
 
• The focus is on ensuring that the cost of finished goods produced is accurately measured for proper inventory valuation and cost control.
 
• Ultimately, the Manufacturing Account helps in determining the efficiency and effectiveness of the production process.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cost of goods sold:**

 
 
• This is calculated in the Trading Account, not the Manufacturing Account. The cost of goods sold includes the cost of finished goods sold during the period.
 
• It is derived by adding the cost of purchases to the opening stock and then subtracting the closing stock.
 
 
 
• **Gross profit:**
 
 
• Gross profit is calculated in the Trading Account by subtracting the cost of goods sold from the sales revenue.
 
• It indicates the profitability of core business activities before deducting operating expenses.
 
 
 
• **Net profit:**
 
 
• Net profit is determined in the Profit and Loss Account after accounting for all operating expenses, non-operating incomes, and non-operating expenses.
 
• It represents the overall profitability of the business.
